title: Startup Refusal to Pay ₹45,000 Contractor Invoices
respondent: NextGen FinTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (Director: Alok Bansal)
narrative: I signed a freelance design contract with NextGen FinTech Solutions on August 1, 2024 to deliver a complete mobile design design system and 25 UI screens for their consumer lending app for a total fee of ₹45,000. Deliverables were completed on schedule and formally approved by the CEO Alok Bansal over Slack and Email on August 28. I submitted my tax invoice (Invoice #MK-2024-08, ₹45,000) on September 1 with standard 15-day payment terms. Since September 15, the founder has been dodging payment. Initially he cited 'payment gateway migration', then 'pending angel investor tranche', and for the past 40 days has stopped replying to emails, WhatsApp messages, and phone calls, even though the startup recently launched the new app in public beta using my exact Figma screens and UI assets. I have the signed agreement, email approval of deliverables, invoice PDF, WhatsApp payment promise chats, and screenshots of their live app using my copyrighted design.
